simple.summary: צָלָה (tsâlâh) means to roast First listed occurrence: 1Sam 2 15.

definitions.full: H6740. tsalah [ צָלָה ] verb roast flesh (Late Hebrew id. ; so Arabic , Ethiopic ); — Qal Imperfect 3masculine singular צָלִי יִצְלֶה Isa 44:16 he roasteth a roast ; 1 singular בָשָׂר אֶצְלֶה 44:19 ; Infinitive construct לִצְלוֺת 1Sam 2:15 give flesh ( בָּשָׂר ) to roast.
